description: This file contains unit tests for the IPC (Inter-Process Communication) interface related to obtaining a CDM (Content Decryption Module) key session ID in a media key management system. It defines test cases for success, failure, disconnection, reconnection, and error scenarios, utilizing mock objects and protobuf messages.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysIpcGetCdmKeySessionIdTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the IPC interface for getting CDM key session IDs, derived from MediaKeysIpcTestBase, with setup and teardown for IPC communication and helper methods for response simulation.

methods.name: setGetCdmKeySessionIdResponseSuccess
methods.description: Sets a successful response with a specific CDM key session ID.

methods.name: setGetCdmKeySessionIdResponseFailed
methods.description: Sets a failed response with an error status.
